title: Skyworth 7S60_A5 (board 6A658B, sky8S34), China market, Coocaa OS on Android 8.0 (API 26)
header:
Skyworth 7S60_A5 (board 6A658B, sky8S34), China market, Coocaa OS on Android 8.0 (API 26)
Build OPR5.170623.014 / 022.008.220, armeabi-v7a, about 1.9 GB RAM.
Stock home: com.tianci.movieplatform (com.coocaa.homepage.vast.HomePageActivity; elder mode
com.ccos.cooui.movieplatform.ElderMainActivity). TV/inputs: com.skyworth.tv.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/skyworth-7s60-a5/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/skyworth-7s60-a5/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Disabled before this debloat, so not listed (restore.sh would turn them ON):
com.bajintech.karaok, com.coocaa.activecenter.

Coocaa OS has no Android HOME chooser and ignores set-home-activity: the launcher goes in through
a small homepage shim instead, see README.md in this folder. Tested in October 2026.

apps.note: push service with Sensors Data analytics
usage reporting on boot, screen and app install
Baidu SDK service started at boot
karaoke mic tuning, starts at boot
far-field mic AI service, starts at boot

sections.title: Coocaa extras, unused with the new home (by choice)

apps.note: system message box, pushes notices and promotions
Coocaa payment centre; breaks Coocaa membership purchases
Coocaa account centre; breaks Coocaa account login
cast component updater; casting itself still works
